survey.name: Social feed
survey.res: Sunday bread experiment, attempt number four. Finally got the crust right. Half of this disappeared before it had even cooled down 😂

Maya Bennett
2 h ·
We said we were going for a quick walk. Three hours and one very steep hill later… absolutely worth it.

Ben Carter
38 min ·
Took the long way home and found this little street. Making a mental note to come back when the roses are out.

Elena Morris
1 h ·
A few days by the sea was exactly what we needed. This was the view on the morning coffee walk.

Sam Rivera
3 h ·
Three weeks ago these were tiny cuttings in a jam jar. Now I apparently have a windowsill herb garden 🌱

Priya Shah
54 min ·
Rain canceled our plans, so I’m calling this an excellent alternative. Tea, a blanket and the book I keep meaning to finish.

Jordan Ellis
25 min ·
First watercolor class done. The sky was supposed to be blue, but I’m choosing to call it creative freedom.

Theo Park
4 h ·
Our extremely ambitious weekend plan: bring lunch to the park and stay until the coffee runs out.

Amara Brooks
1 h ·
The kitchen smells incredible. Trying very hard to save some of this loaf for breakfast tomorrow.

Nora Patel
47 min ·
Found a quieter route along the river. A little longer, a lot nicer. This might become the regular Sunday ride.

Luca Reed
2 h ·
No alarm, no rush, and the good mug. Keeping Saturday morning exactly like this for as long as possible.

Maya Bennett
31 min ·
The weather forecast said cloudy. I’m very happy it was wrong. Even remembered to pack enough snacks this time.

Ben Carter
5 h ·
The neighborhood is looking especially good this week. Whoever planted all these flowers deserves a thank-you.

Elena Morris
2 h ·
Went down to the harbor before everyone else woke up. Just the boats, the gulls and a very peaceful half hour.

Sam Rivera
1 h ·
The basil has officially survived longer than any of my previous attempts. The secret seems to be not watering it every time I walk past.

Priya Shah
3 h ·
Picked up a few books at the weekend swap. Came home with more than I brought, which probably defeats the point.

Jordan Ellis
49 min ·
Cleared a corner of the table and got the paints out again. It’s been months. Forgot how quickly an afternoon disappears doing this.

Theo Park
2 h ·
Everyone brought “just a little something” for lunch. We could have fed the entire park.

Amara Brooks
3 h ·
Made a loaf for a neighbor and then had to make another one because the house smelled too good to give it all away.

Nora Patel
1 h ·
First ride after finally fixing that squeaky brake. Amazing how much more peaceful cycling is without a soundtrack.

Luca Reed
42 min ·
A small victory: got up early enough to read a chapter before the day started. Might even try it again tomorrow.

Maya Bennett
2 h ·
Still finding sand in my shoes from this walk. No complaints. Already planning the next one.

Ben Carter
6 h ·
Walked to the local bakery instead of driving. Took twice as long because I stopped to look at every garden along the way.

Elena Morris
1 h ·
One last photo from our little coastal break. The kind of place where you immediately start talking about coming back.

Sam Rivera
4 h ·
Fresh mint for tea, basil for dinner. Feeling ridiculously proud of these little pots.

Priya Shah
35 min ·
Put my phone in the other room and actually read for an hour. Leaving this here as a reminder to do that more often.

Jordan Ellis
3 h ·
The table is a mess and there’s paint on my sleeve, but I’m pretty pleased with how this one is coming along.

Theo Park
58 min ·
Last-minute picnic before the weather turns. Bread, cheese, pears. Sometimes the simple plan is the best one.

Amara Brooks
2 h ·
Tried the overnight dough recipe everyone keeps recommending. Very little effort, very good toast. This one’s staying in the rotation.

Nora Patel
5 h ·
Stopped here for five minutes and somehow stayed for twenty. Hard to hurry when the river looks like this.

Luca Reed
